description: Team Space Health Monito is driven by a passion for Artificial Intelligence, software innovation, and space exploration. Based out of Hyderabad, we are building advanced, data-driven solutions for theCreate Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missionschallenge. We are actively looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in web development, AI/ML, and data analysis to build a robust, mission-critical prototype. Let's build the future of space health together!
